duplicateExecution: absent; the workflow is dispatch-only and one run was created
result: The first bounded weekly matrix dispatch completed. The fast subset and Android consumer passed. Static checks reproduced the known baseline. BuildKit is an environment failure from rootless Podman user namespaces. The vmsync end-to-end test has a path defect. Categories with no qualified command are recorded incomplete.
limits: This is the first dispatch; a clean idempotent re-dispatch is still required.
The BuildKit category did not produce an image because the sandbox could not create the rootless namespace.
The vmsync failure is a test-path defect; it is not evidence against the VM capability.
The incomplete categories have no qualified command yet and are not coverage.

reDispatch.result: The clean re-dispatch reproduced the same category outcomes and produced one run.

retryAfterFixes.changed: vmsync path resolved to the mvm CLI, but the VM step then failed because qemu-img was absent; BuildKit still failed on the rootless Podman namespace with PODMAN_USERNS=host

retryAfterQemu.changed: qemu-img was installed; mvm then required virsh/libvirt, which the sandbox does not provide. BuildKit still failed on the rootless Podman namespace.

retryAfterLibvirt.changed: libvirt and qemu-utils installed and a user session daemon started; virsh define then failed because no qemu-system-x86_64 emulator was installed

retryAfterQemuSystem.changed: qemu-system-x86 enabled VM creation; the VM then had no virtiofsd, so push fell back to the guest agent and rejected the relative test path. Rootful podman build rejected --cpus.

buildkitSuccess.changed: rootful Podman built the terminal and IDE images. VM creation then failed to start because the virtiofs chardev socket was refused.

vmGuestProgress.changed: VM created and the bundle push used the guest-agent path; mise then failed because the guest lacked libatomic1

libatomicOrdering.changed: VM and BuildKit succeeded up to guest Node setup; the libatomic install still ran after Node and was moved earlier.

finalSuccess.result: All named real matrix categories pass: fast subset, Android, BuildKit and the Linux VM lifecycle. Static reproduces the known baseline; categories without a qualified command are incomplete.
